location.value: Can be dropped by Skeletons using this weapon.; Shadow of the Erdtree: Dragon's Pit From the Dragon's Pit [ Map Link ] site of grace, run down into the cave and drop off the first ledge. You will land near a small beastman skeleton you can slay to keep it from bothering you, then kill the larger one bearing the Executioner's Greataxe. A quick run up the ramp to the right will return you to the grace for another attempt.; The Church of Irith Graveyard. From the Lake-Facing Cliffs [ Map Link ] site of grace in Liurnia of the Lakes , head west from the Church of Irith. Follow the cliff until you reach the top where you will find a small graveyard with two Skeletons hanging from a tree. Getting closer will spawn a Skeleton wielding the Executioner's Greataxe to the right of the monument with the Warming Stone in a small grave patch.
